text: 佢喺音樂、電影、文學同流行文化中嘅寫照令到呢座城市同佢嘅地標聞名於世。
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: 三藩市開發咗一個大型旅遊基建設施，擁有眾多酒店、餐廳同一流嘅會議設施。
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: 三藩市亦係全國食其他亞洲美食（韓國菜、泰國菜、印度菜、日本菜）嘅絕佳地方。
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: 去迪士尼樂園旅行對好多美國家庭嚟講係一次重大嘅朝聖之旅。
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: 「典型」嘅遊覽方式包括飛去奧蘭多國際機場，搭車去迪士尼酒店，喺唔離開迪士尼酒店嘅情況下度過大約一個禮拜，然後返屋企。
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: 雖然大家嘅遊玩方法唔同，但呢個係大多數人講緊「要去迪士尼世界」嗰時所表達嘅意思。
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: 好多透過eBay或Craigslist等拍賣網站喺網上出售嘅門票都係使用過部分日子嘅多日跨園通行門票。
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: 雖然噉樣做法非常普遍，但係迪士尼禁止噉做：門票唔可以轉讓。
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: 任何人喺大峽谷邊緣下露營都需要攞野外許可證。
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: 為咗保護峽谷，許可證係有限嘅，喺露營月份四個月當月嘅第1日可供預訂。
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: 所以，5月任何一日開始嘅野外許可證將會喺1月1號發放。
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: 最受歡迎嘅地區，譬如幽靈牧場附近嘅光明天使露營地，通常喺第一日開放預訂時就收到大量嘅預訂請求。
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: 預留畀臨時預約申請嘅許可證數量有限，先到先得。
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: 揸車進入南非係一種欣賞呢個地區美景嘅絕佳方式，同時又係前往一般旅遊路線以外嘅地方嘅絕佳方式。
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: 雖然喺仔細規劃之下，用普通車都可以做到，但係強烈建議用四驅車，好多地方只能夠用高軸距四驅車先可以到達。
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: 喺規劃時謹記，雖然南非穩定，但並非所有鄰國都係咁穩定嘅。
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: 簽證要求同簽證費因國家而異，並受到你嘅原籍國影響。
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: 每個國家都有獨特嘅法律要求車內一定要攜帶邊啲應急物品。
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: 維多利亞瀑布係津巴布韋西部嘅一座城鎮，同贊比亞利文斯頓接壤，靠近博茨瓦納。
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: 呢個城鎮緊鄰瀑布主要景點，正正係呢個受歡迎嘅旅遊景點吸引咗大量探險者同觀光遊客，令佢哋願意逗留更長時間。
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: 喺雨季（11月至3月），水量會增多，瀑布睇起嚟亦都會更壯觀。
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: 如果過橋或者沿住瀑布附近嘅小徑行，一定會淋濕。
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: 另一方面，正正因為水量太高，你實際睇到嘅瀑布景象都會畀大量嘅水遮住！
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: 圖坦卡門陵墓（KV62）。KV62可能係帝王谷中最出名嘅陵墓，1922年霍華德·卡特喺呢度發現咗呢位年輕國王近乎完好無損嘅皇家陵墓。
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: 不過，同大部分其他皇家陵墓相比，圖坦卡門嘅陵墓唔太值得參觀，規模太細，裝飾又有限。
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: 木乃伊嘗試出棺時造成損傷，所有想睇木乃伊受損嘅證據嘅人士都會好失望，皆因只可以睇到頭部同膊頭。
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: 呢座陵墓嘅大量陪葬品早已經不復存在，已經轉移到開羅嘅埃及博物館。
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: 建議時間有限嘅遊客去其他地方參觀。
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: 格羅姆寺位於暹粒西南12公里。呢座山頂寺廟建於9世紀末，耶輸跋摩國王統治時期。
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: 寺廟嘅陰森氣氛同洞里薩湖嘅景色令到爬山都值回票價。
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: 參觀呢個景點可以順便搭船遊湖。
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: 入廟需要吳哥通行證，所以去洞里薩嗰陣記得帶埋護照。
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: 耶路撒冷係以色列嘅首都同最大城市，但大多數其他國家同聯合國唔承認呢度係以色列首都。
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: 呢座坐落唙朱迪亞山上嘅古城有跨越幾千年嘅迷人歷史。
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: 呢座城市是三大一神教——猶太教、基督教同伊斯蘭教——嘅聖地，而且係精神、宗教、文化中心。
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: 由於呢座城市嘅宗教意義，特別係老城地區嘅好多景點，耶路撒冷係以色列主要旅遊目的地之一。
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: 耶路撒冷有好多歷史、考古同文化遺址，仲有充滿活力、人山人海嘅購物中心、咖啡店同餐廳。
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: 厄瓜多爾要求古巴公民收到邀請函之後先可以通過國際機場或邊境入境點入境厄瓜多爾。
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: 呢封函件一定要得到厄瓜多爾外交部法律認可，並符合某啲要求。
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: 呢啲要求係為咗規定兩國之間移民流動有序進行。
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: 持有美國綠卡嘅古巴公民應前往厄瓜多爾領事館嚟獲得呢項要求嘅豁免。
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: 你嘅護照必須喺旅遊日期後至少6個月有效，亦需要一張往返/續程機票嚟證明你嘅逗留時間。
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: 報團人數越多，旅費越抵，所以如果你一個人或者淨係同一個朋友一齊，試下結識其他人，組成一個四人到六人嘅旅行團，噉樣人均價格更加抵。
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: 不過，你真係唔應該擔心呢方面，皆因啲遊客經常畀人車住周圍去塞滿車先走。
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: 咁樣實際上更似係一種詐騙方式，等佢哋以為必須畀更多嘅錢。
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: 馬丘比丘北端嘅雲端之處係呢座陡峭嘅山峰，經常係有關呢座遺跡嘅好多靚相嘅背景。
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: 從下面睇有啲嚇人，而且路又斜又難爬，不過大多數身體健康嘅人應該可以喺大概45分鐘內爬完。
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: 大部分路段沿路都鋪設咗石級。喺比較斜嘅路段，鋼絲索可作當做支撐嘅扶手。
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: 亦即係話，要做好上氣唔接下氣嘅準備，喺更斜嘅地方要小心，尤其係濕滑路段，因為行得快可能會變得好危險。
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: 喺山頂附近有一個必須穿過去嘅小山窿，又矮又窄。
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: 參觀加拉帕戈斯嘅景點同野生動物最好係坐船，就好似查爾斯·達爾文喺1835年所做嘅一樣。
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: 60幾艘遊船定期來回加拉帕戈斯水域，可以載8至100人不等。
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: 大多數人都提前訂好咗位（因為旺季嘅時候船通常都客滿）。
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: 請確保幫你預訂嘅代理係熟悉各種船隻嘅加拉帕戈斯專家。
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: 噉樣可以確保你嘅特殊興趣或者限制同最適合佢哋嘅船隻相配。
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: 喺16世紀西班牙人嚟到之前，智利北部畀印加帝國統治，而土著阿勞砍人（馬普切人）就居住喺智利中部同南部。
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: 馬普切人亦都係最後一個獨立嘅美洲土著族群之一，直到智利獨立之後，佢哋先至完全融入西班牙語國家嘅統治。
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: 雖然智利喺1810年宣佈獨立（拿破侖戰爭期間西班牙喺幾年之內都冇一個正常運作嘅中央政府），但直到1818年先取得對西班牙嘅決定性勝利。
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: 多明尼加共和國（西班牙語：República Dominica a）係一個加勒比國家，位於伊斯帕尼奧拉島嘅東半部，同海地接壤。
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: 除咗白色沙灘同山地景觀，呢個國家仲係美洲最古老嘅歐洲城市所在地，而家係聖多明各嘅一部分。
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: 泰諾人同加勒比人最先居住喺呢個島上。加勒比人講阿拉瓦克文，大概喺公元前10000年嚟到呢度。
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: 喺歐洲探險家嚟到之後嘅短短幾年內，泰諾人嘅人口因為西班牙嘅征服而大幅減少。
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: 根據巴托洛梅·德斯拉卡薩斯修道士 (《西印度群島條約》) 所講，喺1492年至1498年間，西班牙征服者殺死咗大約100000個泰諾人。
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: 聯合花園。呢個地方係17世紀一個修道院嘅中庭，而聖地亞哥神廟就係唯一僅存嘅建築。
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: 佢而家已經成為中央廣場，無論日夜，呢度總係會進行好多活動。
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: 花園周圍有好多餐廳，下晝同夜晚經常會喺中央涼亭舉辦免費音樂會。
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso（接吻小巷）。兩個陽台只係隔著69厘米，係一個舊時愛情傳說嘅地方。
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: 只需幾個仙仔，一啲細孥就會同你講故事。
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: 寶雲島係一個好受歡迎嘅一日遊或者週末短途遊打卡地，有皮划艇、遠足、商店同餐廳等。
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: 呢個地道嘅社區位於溫哥華郊外附近嘅豪灣，從溫哥華市中心嘅格蘭佛島出發，搭定時出發嘅水上的士好容易去到。
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: 對於嗰啲鍾意戶外活動嘅人嚟講，梗係要沿住海天走廊行山啦。
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: 威斯勒（距離溫哥華個半鐘車程）物價昂貴，但因為2010年冬奧會而出名。
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: 喺冬天可以享受北美最好嘅滑雪體驗，喺夏天可以試下真正嘅山地單車。
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: 一定要提前預訂許可證。你必須持有喺塞雷納過夜嘅許可證。
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: 塞雷納係唯一一個除咗露營之外仲提供宿舍住宿同熱餐嘅護林站。拉萊昂納、聖佩德羅同帕托斯淨係提供露營服務，唔提供餐飲服務。
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: 可以直接從希門尼斯港嘅護林站獲得公園許可證，但佢哋唔收信用卡。
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: 公園管理局（MINAE）唔會喺預計抵達日期前超過一個月簽發公園許可證。
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Cafenet El Sol提供預訂服務，收費 30 美元，或者提供一日通行證，收費 10 美元；詳情可以參見佢哋嘅科爾科瓦多網頁。
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: 庫克群島係一個同紐西蘭自由聯合嘅島國，位於南太平洋中部嘅波利尼西亞。
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: 群島由15個島嶼組成，散落喺220萬平方公里嘅海洋上面。
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: 由於同夏威夷嘅時區一樣，呢啲島嶼有時被認為係「南方夏威夷」。
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: 雖然呢度比較細，但係令一啲年紀大嘅遊客諗起夏威夷喺成為一個州之前冇大型旅遊酒店同其他開發項目嘅情景。
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: 雖然庫克群島冇任何城市，但係由15個唔同嘅島嶼組成。主要嘅島嶼有拉羅湯加同艾圖塔基。
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: 喺今時今日嘅發達國家，提供豪華大床同早餐已經昇華成為一種藝術形式。
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: 喺高端市場，民宿好明顯主要喺兩個方面展開競爭：床上用品同早餐。
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: 所以，喺呢類最精緻嘅場所，大家好容易搵到最豪華嘅床鋪，可能係手工製作嘅被或者古董床。
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: 早餐可能包括當地嘅時令美食或者由主人烹調嘅特色菜。
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: 場景可能係一座歷史悠久嘅舊建築，配有古董傢俬、修剪整齊嘅草地同泳池。
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: 坐上自己嘅車，出發去長途自駕遊，箇中嘅簡單體驗有內在嘅吸引力。
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: 唔似得大型車，你可能已經揸慣你架車，知道佢嘅局限性。
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: 喺私人物業或任何規模嘅城鎮搭帳篷都好容易引起不必要嘅關注。
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: 簡單嚟講，揸車係自駕遊嘅一種好方式，但佢本身好少係一種「露營」方式。
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: 如果你有一架座椅可以攤平嘅大型迷你貨van、SUV、轎車或者旅行車，就可以去汽車露營。
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: 有啲酒店嘅歷史可以追溯到蒸汽鐵路同遠洋客輪黃金時代；即係19世紀或20世紀初第二次世界大戰之前。
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: 呢啲酒店係當時嘅有錢人同名人下榻嘅地方，經常有精緻嘅餐飲同夜生活。
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: 懷舊傢俬、冇最新嘅設施同埋某種優雅嘅古典味道亦都係佢哋特色嘅一部分。
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: 雖然佢哋通常屬於私人擁有，但有時都會招待來訪嘅國家元首同其他政要。
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: 如果一個旅客有一大堆錢，可能會考慮環球飛行，會喺當中好多嘅酒店住宿。
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: 好客嘅交流網絡係將旅客同佢哋要去嘅城市嘅本地人連繫起嚟嘅組織。
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: 加入噉樣一個網絡通常只需要喺網上填寫一份表格；不過某啲網絡會提供或需要額外嘅驗證。
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: 然後會以紙本或者網上形式提供一份可提供服務嘅主人名單，有時仲會提供其他旅客嘅推薦同評論。
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: 2004年1月，電腦程式員凱西·芬頓搵到一班飛往冰島嘅平價航班，但冇地方住，於是成立咗Couchsurfing。
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: 佢發電郵畀當地大學嘅學生，收到咗大量免費住宿嘅邀請。
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: 旅館主要面向年輕人——一般客人20幾歲——但你亦都可以經常喺嗰度搵到年紀大嘅旅客。
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: 帶住小朋友嘅家庭好少見，但一啲旅館確實允許佢哋入住私人房間。
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: 中國北京即將成為2022年冬奧會嘅主辦城市，呢度將會成為第一個同時舉辦夏季奧運會同冬季奧運會嘅城市。
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: 北京將會舉辦開幕式、閉幕式同室內冰上項目。
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: 其他滑雪項目將會喺張家口太子城滑雪場舉行，距離北京大約220公里（140英哩）。
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: 大多數寺廟都有一年一度嘅節日，由11月下旬開始到5月中旬結束，視乎每個寺廟嘅年曆而有唔同。
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: 大多數寺廟嘅節日都係慶祝寺廟嘅週年紀念日、主神嘅生日或者同寺廟有關嘅其他重大事件嘅一部分。
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: 喀拉拉邦嘅廟會非常有趣，有扮得靚靚嘅大象定期巡遊、寺廟樂團以及其他慶祝活動。
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: 世界博覽會（通常叫萬國博覽會，或簡稱世博會）係一個大型嘅國際藝術科學節。
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: 參展國家喺國家館舉辦藝術教育展覽，展示世界議題或本國文化、歷史。
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: 世界園藝博覽會係專門展示花卉展覽、植物園以及其他與植物有關展覽嘅活動。
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: 雖然理論上可以每年舉行一次（只要喺唔同嘅國家），但實際上唔得。
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: 呢啲活動喺邊度都要通常持續三到六個月，舉辦地點面積唔少於50公頃。
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: 多年嚟我哋用過好多唔同格式嘅菲林。標準35毫米菲林（36x24毫米負片）係最常見嘅。
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: 如果用完，菲林通常相當容易補貨，並且解像度大致相當於而家嘅單反。
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: 有啲中片幅菲林相機使用6x6厘米嘅格式，準確啲講係56x56毫米負片。
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: 噉樣嘅解像度幾乎係35毫米負片嘅4倍（3136平方毫米對864平方毫米）。
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: 捕捉野生動物係對攝影師最大嘅挑戰，當中唔少得運氣、耐性、經驗同良好嘅設備。
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: 野生動物攝影通常睇落簡單，但就好似一般嘅攝影一樣，一張相勝過千言萬語。
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: 野生動物攝影通常需要一個長焦鏡頭，不過好似一群雀鳥或一隻微細生物之類就需要其他鏡頭。
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: 好多奇異動物好難搵到，公園有時亦都出於商業目的訂立拍攝守則。
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: 野生動物可能會怕羞或者有攻擊性。環境可能會好凍、好熱，或者其他惡劣情況都有。
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: 世界上有5000幾種唔同嘅語言，其中20幾種使用者人數高達5000萬或以上。
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: 書面語通常比口語更容易理解。地址尤其係噉，佢哋通常好難清楚發音。
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: 好多國家嘅人都識講流利嘅英文，而喺更多國家，佢哋嘅英文水平就有限，尤其係年輕人。
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: 你可以想像，一個曼庫尼人、波士頓人、牙買加人同悉尼人喺多倫多嘅一間餐廳圍住坐埋一枱食晚飯。
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: 佢哋用獨特嘅口音同當地嘅黑話講家鄉故事，互相分享。
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: 喺超市買嘢食通常係最抵嘅。如果冇機會煮嘢食，噉就只能揀現成食品。
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: 越嚟越多超市提供種類更豐富嘅現成食品。有啲甚至提供微波爐或者其他方式嚟加熱食物。
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: 喺一啲鄉村或者某類商店，場內至少有一間餐廳，通常係價格實惠嘅非正式餐廳。
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: 打印並隨身攜帶你嘅保單副本同保險公司嘅聯絡方式。
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: 保單上面需要顯示保險公司嘅電郵地址同國際電話號碼，以便獲得建議/授權同提出索償。
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: 喺你個行李箱同網上儲存另一個副本（通過電郵發送畀自己並附上附件，或者存喺「雲端」）。
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: 如果帶手提電腦或者平板電腦旅遊，可以將副本存喺內存或者硬碟裡面（唔使上網就可以開到）。
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: 另外，應該將保單/聯絡方式嘅副本交畀旅伴同願意幫手嘅親友。
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: 駝鹿（又叫麋鹿）天生就唔具有攻擊性，但如果佢哋察覺到威脅，都會自衛。
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: 當人類唔認為駝鹿係潛在危險嘅時候，佢哋可能會靠得太近，將自己置於危險之中。
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: 適量飲酒。酒精對每個人嘅影響都唔一樣，了解自己嘅酒量非常重要。
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: 過量飲酒可能導致嘅長期健康問題包括肝臟損傷，甚至失明同死亡。如果飲咗非法生產嘅酒，就會增加潛在危險。
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: 非法烈酒可能含有各種危險雜質，包括甲醇，就算係好小嘅劑量都會導致失明或者死亡。
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: 眼鏡喺外國可能更平，尤其係喺人力成本比較低嘅低收入國家。
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: 考慮喺國內做眼科檢查（尤其係喺保險保障範圍內），然後將處方帶到其他地方備案。
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: 呢啲地區嘅高端品牌鏡框可能有兩個問題；有啲可能係仿製品，同埋真正進口嘅可能比國內更貴。
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: 咖啡係世界上最大宗嘅商品之一，喺你家鄉可能會搵到好多種咖啡。
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: 就算係噉，世界各地依然有好多獨特嘅飲咖啡方式值得體驗。
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: 溪降運動（或：峽谷漂流）係指進入峽谷底部，峽谷底部一係乾涸，一係充滿水流。
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: 峽谷運動結合咗游水、登山同跳躍嘅元素——不過開始嘅時候對訓練或者體型嘅要求相對較少（例如，同攀岩、水肺潛水或者高山滑雪相比）。
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: 遠足係一種戶外活動，包括喺大自然度散步，通常係喺徒步小徑上散步。
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: 一日遠足嘅距離可以從唔到一英哩到一日之內可以行完嘅更長距離不等。
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: 沿住一條簡單嘅小路遠足一日，幾乎唔使做太多準備，所有身體健康嘅人士都可以享受一日遠足。
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: 有小朋友嘅家庭可能需要準備多啲嘢，但就算有BB同學齡前兒童，都可以喺戶外輕鬆度過一日。
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: 喺國際上，有近200間跑步旅遊公司。其中大多數係獨立營運嘅。
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Go Running Tours（前身係The Global Running Tours）喺四大洲網羅咗好多觀光公司。
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: 佢源於巴塞隆拿嘅 Running Tours Barcelona 同哥本哈根嘅 Running Copenhagen，好快就擴展到布拉格嘅 Running Tours Prague 同其他地方。
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: 喺去某個地方旅遊之前同旅遊期間，有好多嘢都需要考慮。
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: 當你旅遊嘅時候，唔使望一切都好似「返鄉下」噉。禮儀、法律、食物、交通、住宿、標準、語言等等都會喺某程度上同你住嘅地方唔同。
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: 你需要時刻記住呢一點，以免對當地嘅做事方式覺得失望，甚至反感。
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: 旅行社自19世紀就已經出現。旅行社通常係一個唔錯嘅選擇，佢超越咗旅行者過往對自然、文化、語言或低收入國家嘅體驗。
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: 雖然大多數旅行社都肯接受大部分旅程預訂，但好多旅行社都會專門提供特定類型嘅旅遊、預算範圍或者目的地。
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: 最好搵一間經常預訂同你嘅旅程類似嘅旅行社。
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: 睇下旅行社推廣緊嘅旅遊線路，無論係喺網站上定係喺門店櫥窗上面。
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: 如果你想以平靚正嘅價錢去睇世界，不論係為咗慳旅費、體驗生活方式定係挑戰，都有幾個方法可以做到。
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: 基本上可以分為兩種：一邊旅遊一邊做嘢，或者盡量限制開支。呢篇文嘅重點係後者。
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: 對於嗰啲願意犧牲舒適度、時間同希望將開支降到近乎零嘅人，請參考最低預算嘅旅行。
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: 呢個建議係假設旅客唔會為咗自己嘅利益而偷竊、擅闖私人地方、參與黑市、行乞或者以其他方式剝削其他人。
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: 入境檢查站通常係落機、落船或者落其他車嘅第一站。
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: 喺一啲跨境列車上面，入境檢查係喺行駛嘅列車上進行嘅，而你上火車嘅時候就要隨身攜帶有效嘅證件。
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: 喺過夜火車上面，車長可能會先收集護照，噉樣就唔會打攪你瞓覺。
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: 登記係簽證流程嘅附加要求。喺某啲國家，你必須向當局登記你嘅資料同留宿地址。
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: 噉樣可能要到當地警局或者去入境管理處填寫表格。
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: 喺好多有呢項法律規定嘅國家，當地酒店會辦理登記手續（記得要問）。
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: 喺其他情況下，只有嗰啲住喺旅遊住宿設施以外嘅旅客先要登記。不過，噉樣令到法律變得更加模糊，所以要事先了解清楚。
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: 建築學涉及建築物嘅設計同建造。一個地方嘅建築本身往往就係一個旅游景點。
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: 好多建築物睇起嚟相當靚，從高樓或者位置巧妙嘅窗口都可以睇到一幅靚景。
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: 建築同城市規劃、土木工程、裝飾藝術、室內設計、景觀設計等其他領域有相當大嘅重疊。
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: 考慮到好多普韋布洛嘅偏遠程度，如果唔去阿爾伯克基或者聖達菲，你就搵唔到多姿多彩嘅夜生活。
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: 不過，幾乎所有上面列出嘅賭場都提供飲品，其中幾間賭場仲帶嚟知名品牌娛樂活動（主要係阿爾伯克基同聖達菲附近嘅大型賭場）。
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: 注意：呢度啲小鎮酒吧並唔見得係外地遊客去玩嘅好去處。
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: 首先，新墨西哥州北部有嚴重嘅醉駕問題，而且小鎮酒吧附近係醉駕司機高度集中嘅地方。
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: 討厭嘅壁畫或者亂塗亂畫被稱之為塗鴉。
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: 雖然塗鴉遠遠唔係一個現代現象，不過大多數人可能會將佢同年輕人用噴漆破壞公私財產聯想起嚟。
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: 不過，而家有知名嘅塗鴉藝術家、塗鴉活動同「合法」嘅塗鴉墻。喺呢種背景下，塗鴉往往更似係藝術品，而唔係難以辨認嘅標簽。
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: 掟回力鏢係一項好多遊客都想學嘅熱門技術。
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: 如果你想學識將回力鏢掟返到你手上，噉就要確保你隻回力鏢適合迴旋。
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: 事實上，澳洲嘅大多數回力鏢都係唔識迴旋嘅。新手最好唔好嘗試喺翻風嗰陣掟。
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Hangi餐係喺地下嘅熱坑裡面煮嘢食。
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: 呢個坑會以火燒過嘅熱石加熱，或者喺一啲地熱令地面自然變熱嘅地方。
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi經常會用嚟煮傳統嘅燒烤式晚餐。
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: 羅托路亞有幾個地方提供地熱Hangi，而基督城、威靈頓同其他地方亦都可以試到其他Hangi。
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: 開普敦市內同周邊地區嘅輕軌通勤列車有兩個等級：MetroPlus（亦稱為頭等艙）同Metro（稱為三等艙）。
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus更加舒適、冇咁逼人。雖然價錢貴少少，但仲係平過歐洲普通地鐵飛。
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: 每架火車都有MetroPlus同Metro車廂；MetroPlus車廂一向都係喺火車尾，離開普敦最近。
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: 幫其他人帶嘢——視線永遠唔好離開啲行李，尤其係當你過緊國際邊境嘅時候。
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: 你可能會發現自己喺唔知情嘅情況下畀人用嚟運毒，噉會令你陷入好大嘅麻煩。
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: 當中包括排隊等候，因為當局可以唔聲唔聲噉隨時使用緝毒犬。
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: 有啲國家甚至對初犯都有極之嚴厲嘅懲罰；其中可以包括10年以上嘅監禁或者死刑。
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: 冇人看管嘅行李袋係盜竊嘅目標，亦都會引起提防炸彈威脅嘅當局注意。
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: 喺國內，由於經常接觸本地嘅細菌，你好大機會已經對佢哋免疫。
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: 但喺世界其他地方，細菌動物群對你嚟講係陌生嘅，你遇到問題嘅可能性更大。
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: 另外，喺溫暖嘅氣候，細菌喺體外生長速度更快，生存時間更長。
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: 從而催生咗「德里腹」、「法老嘅詛咒」、「蒙特祖瑪嘅復仇」之類嘅別稱。
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: 就好似寒冷氣候下嘅呼吸系統問題一樣，炎熱氣候下嘅腸道問題相當常見，但多數只係明顯不適嘅症狀，並唔太危險。
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: 如果第一次喺發展中國家旅遊或者喺喺新發掘嘅地方旅遊，唔好低估潛在嘅文化衝擊。
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: 發展中國家旅行嘅新事物考起咗唔少經驗老到嘅旅客，好多微細嘅文化調整迅速累積起嚟會令人吃不消。
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: 尤其係喺你初到嗰幾日，可以考慮喺西式高質素酒店、食物同服務方面揮霍一下，幫助自己適應環境。
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: 喺你唔了解當地動物生態嘅地方，千祈唔好瞓喺床褥或者地墊上。
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: 如果你要露營，請帶備露營床或者吊床，以防有蛇同蠍子等等。
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: 朝早喺屋企飲返杯香濃咖啡，夜晚飲啲洋甘菊茶放鬆下。
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: 當你宅喺屋企嗰陣，有時間獎勵下自己，用多幾分鐘時間煮啲特別嘅嘢。
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: 如果你想再冒險一啲，趁機榨下果汁或者攪啲奶昔：
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: 或者你會發明一種喺妳返到日常生活時可以當早餐嘅簡單飲品。
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: 如果你生活喺一個擁有多元飲酒文化嘅城市，噉就去啲你唔經常去嘅街區蒲吧或者落pub。
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: 對於嗰啲唔熟悉醫學術語嘅人嚟講，「傳染」同「接觸性傳染」呢兩個詞有唔同嘅意思。
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: 傳染病係由病原體引起嘅疾病，好似病毒、細菌、真菌或者其他寄生蟲。
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: 接觸性傳染病係一種喺感染者附近好容易被傳播嘅疾病。
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: 好多國家政府要求入境旅客或離境國民接種針對一系列疾病疫苗。
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: 呢啲要求往往取決於旅客去過或者打算去嘅國家。
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: 北卡羅萊納州夏洛特市嘅優勢之一就係為家庭提供咗豐富嘅高質素選擇。
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: 嚟自其他地區嘅居民經常將家庭友好作為搬到呢度嘅主要原因，遊客通常發現，有小朋友喺身邊好容易享受到呢座城市。
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: 喺過去嘅20年，夏洛特上城區裡面方便小朋友嘅選擇數量幾何級數增加。
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: 夏洛特嘅家庭通常唔搭的士，但喺某啲情況下的士會有啲用處。
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: 因為超過2個乘客就要額外收費，所以呢種選擇可能會比必要嘅收費更加貴。
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: 南極洲係地球上最凍嘅地方，圍繞住南極。
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: 旅遊費用高昂，需要身體健康，只能喺夏季11月至2月進行，而且主要僅限於半島、島嶼同羅斯海。
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: 夏天有幾千個工作人員住喺呢度嘅40幾個基地，大部分喺呢啲地區；少數人留喺呢度過冬。
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: 南極洲內陸係一個畀2-3公里嘅冰層覆蓋嘅荒涼高原。
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: 間中會有專業嘅航空旅遊團去內陸，登山或者有大型基地嘅極點。
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: 南極點公路(或高速公路)係從羅斯海嘅麥克默多站到南極點嘅一條長1600公里嘅路線。
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: 呢度雪壓實咗，佈滿裂縫，並用旗仔標示起嚟。去嗰度只能搭專門嘅拖拉機、裝滿燃料同補給嘅雪橇。
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: 佢哋唔係好靈活，所以呢條路要兜住南極橫貫山脈轉好長一段路先可以到達高原。
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: 冬天最常見嘅意外都係因為濕滑嘅路面、行人路，尤其係台階。
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: 至少，你需要一對鞋底合適嘅鞋。夏天嘅鞋喺冰雪上通常好跣，甚至有啲冬天嘅靴都有缺陷。
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: 坑紋要深5毫米(1/5英吋)以上，而且材料喺低溫下要夠軟熟。
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: 有啲靴有飾釘，鑲咗飾釘嘅附加設備可以應付濕滑嘅情況，適用於大多數鞋同靴，專為鞋踭或鞋踭同鞋底而設。
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: 鞋踭應該又低又闊。砂石或者鹽(氯化鈣)要經常糝喺公路或者小路上，用嚟提高摩擦力。
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: 雪崩並唔係一種反常現象；陡峭嘅斜坡只可以承受咁多嘅雪，多餘嘅雪量就好似雪崩噉樣傾瀉而下。
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: 問題係，雪係有黏性嘅，所以佢需要啲觸發事件先會傾瀉，而一部份嘅雪傾瀉可能會連帶觸發其他雪傾瀉落嚟。
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: 最初嘅觸發事件有時係太陽暖雪，有時係降雪增加，有時係其他自然事件，但通常係人為嘅。
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: 龍捲風係一個旋轉嘅極低壓氣柱，佢向內同向上吸入周圍嘅空氣。
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: 佢哋會產生強風(通常係每小時100-200英哩)，而且可以將重物拋上天同龍捲風一齊移動。
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: 佢哋一開始好似漏斗噉從風暴雲裡面下降，當佢哋觸及地面時就變成咗「龍捲風」。
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: 個人VPN(虛擬私人網絡)供應商係規避政治審查同商業IP地理過濾嘅絕佳方式。
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: 佢哋比網頁代理好有幾個原因：佢哋重新路由所有互聯網流量，唔單止係http。
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: 佢哋通常提供嘅頻寬更高，服務質素更好。佢哋係加密嘅，所以好難被監視。
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: 媒體公司經常對噉做嘅目的講大話，口口聲聲話噉係為咗「防止盜版」。
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: 事實上，地區代碼對非法複製絕對冇影響；一個磁碟嘅位元對位元複製本來可以喺任何正本都可以成功播放嘅設備上順利播放。
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: 佢哋實際目的係令呢啲公司對佢哋嘅市場有更多嘅控制權；呢一切都係為咗賺錢。
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: 因為電話係透過網路連線嘅，你唔使用位於居住地或者旅遊地嘅電訊公司。
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: 亦冇要求你從你居住嘅社區獲得本地號碼；你可以喺阿拉斯加州奇金嘅野外獲得衛星網絡連接，然後揀一個號碼，聲稱你喺陽光明媚嘅亞利桑那州。
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: 通常，你要單獨購買一個全球號碼，噉樣公共電話交換網嘅電話先可以打畀你。號碼嘅來源會影響打電話畀你嘅人。
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: 即時文字翻譯應用程式係能夠自動將成段文字由一種語言翻譯成另一種語言嘅應用程式。
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: 當用戶將智能手機指向現實世界裡面嘅標誌或者其他物件時，有啲應用程式甚至可以翻譯呢啲物件上嘅外語文字。
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: 翻譯引擎已經得到咗大幅改良，而家經常畀得出或多或少正確嘅翻譯(而且好少文理不通)，但仲係要小心，因為佢哋依然可能會完全翻譯錯。
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: 喺呢類應用程式裡面，其中一個最突出嘅係Google翻譯，佢可以喺下載所需嘅語言數據之後進行離線翻譯。
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: 喺外國用智能手機上嘅GPS導航應用程式係最簡單、最方便嘅導航方式。
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: 噉樣比起購買新嘅GPS地圖、單獨嘅GPS裝置或者從汽車租賃公司租用GPS裝置更慳錢。
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: 如果你部手機冇數據連線，或者超出範圍，佢哋嘅功能就可能會受到限制或者用唔到。
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: 每個街角嘅店鋪都擺滿咗一排排令人眼花繚亂嘅預繳電話卡，呢啲卡既可以用於付費電話，又可以用於普通電話。
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: 雖然大多數電話卡都可以接通任何地方，但有啲電話卡專門為特定國家群組提供優惠嘅通話收費。
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: 使用呢啲服務通常係通過免費電話號碼獲得嘅，大多數電話都可以免費撥打。
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: 一般攝影嘅規則都可以應用喺拍攝影片上，而且拍攝影片嘅規則可能更多。
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: 如果有嘢唔准影相，咁你都唔可以拍片。
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: 如果要用航拍無人機嘅話，要事前檢查清楚可以影咩，有冇需要申請許可證或其他牌照。
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: 即使喺你所在地唔違法，喺機場附近或者人群上空飛無人機幾乎都係一個壞主意。
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: 而家好少有人唔事先搜尋同格價就直接向航空公司訂票。
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: 有時候，同一航班喺唔同資訊彙集網站上嘅價格可能相差好大，喺預訂前比較搜尋結果同查詢航空公司網站係值得嘅。
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: 雖然以遊客或者商務人士身份短期到訪某啲國家可能唔使辦簽證，不過以國際學生身份去嗰度通常需要比以普通遊客身份逗留更長嘅時間。
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: 一般嚟講，喺任何一個國家長時間逗留都需要你事先攞到簽證。
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: 學生簽證通常同普通嘅旅遊或商務簽證有唔同嘅要求同申請手續。
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: 對於大多數國家，你需要一封嚟自你心儀嘅留學院校發出嘅錄取通知書，以及至少喺課程第一年用嚟應付生活嘅資金證明。
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: 向你希望留學嘅國家所屬院校同移民部門查詢詳細要求。
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: 除非你係外交官，否則喺海外工作通常表示你一定要喺所在嘅國家申報薪俸稅。
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: 薪俸稅喺唔同國家有唔同架構，而稅率同稅階都相差好遠。
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: 喺一啲聯邦制國家，好似美國同加拿大，會同時徵收聯邦級同地方級嘅薪俸稅，所以稅率同稅階可能會視乎地區而有唔同。
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: 雖然你返屋企嗰陣通常都係冇入境檢查嘅，或者只係例行公事，但海關管制可能會好麻煩。
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: 你需要確認乜嘢可以帶，乜嘢唔可以帶，仲要申報所有超過法律限制嘅嘢。
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: 投入旅遊寫作行業最簡單嘅方法就係，就係喺一個成熟嘅旅遊網誌網站上面磨練你嘅技巧。
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: 當你熟悉咗網絡上嘅格式同編輯方法之後，你就可以建立自己嘅網站。
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: 一邊旅遊一邊做義工係一種唔錯嘅行善方式，但唔單止係付出。
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: 喺外國生活同做義工係了解唔同文化、結識新朋友、了解自己、增廣見聞甚至獲得新技能嘅好方法。
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: 呢個方法都可以減低開支同延長逗留時間，因為好多志願工作都會提供住宿同食物，有啲仲可以賺少少薪水。
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: 維京人利用俄羅斯嘅水道進入黑海同裏海。其中部分航線依然可以用。睇下係咪可能需要辦特殊許可證，特殊許可證可能會好難辦。
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: 白海-波羅的海運河主要透過奧內加湖、拉多加湖同聖彼得堡嘅河流同湖泊連接北冰洋同波羅的海。
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: 奧涅加湖亦同伏爾加河相連，所以從裏海經俄羅斯過嚟依然有可能。
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: 請放心，你去到碼頭，一切都會清清楚楚。你會遇到其他搭順風船嘅人，佢哋會同你分享佢哋嘅情報。
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: 基本上，你可張貼告示表示你可以提供協助，喺碼頭上四圍踱下，接近清潔遊艇嘅人，試下同酒吧入面嘅水手接觸，等等。
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: 試下同盡可能多嘅人謦欬。一段時間之後，人人都識得你，而且會提示你邊艘船喺度搵人。
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: 你應該從航空聯盟當中謹慎選擇成日搭嘅航空公司。
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: 雖然直覺上你可能覺得應該揀飛行次數最多嘅航空公司，但你要留意到唔同航空公司嘅優惠可能唔同。喺同一個航空聯盟入面，不同航空公司對於頻密飛行嘅乘客嘅積分回贈可能更加豐富。
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: 阿聯酋航空、阿提哈德航空、卡塔爾航空同土耳其航空等航空公司已經大幅擴展咗佢哋對非洲嘅服務，並以比其他歐洲航空公司更有競爭力嘅價格提供咗連接非洲好多主要城市嘅航線。
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: 截至2014年爲止，土耳其航空公司可以飛往30個非洲國家嘅39個目的地。
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: 如果你有更多嘅旅遊時間，你可以將你去非洲嘅單程機票價錢同環球機票價錢比較下。
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: 唔好忘記計算除咗去非洲之外所有地方嘅額外簽證費、離境稅同埋地面交通等費用。
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: 如果你想喺南半球全面環球飛行，由於冇越洋航線，航班同目的地嘅選擇係好有限嘅。
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: 冇一個航空公司聯盟可以覆蓋嗮南半球所有三條跨洋航線（天合聯盟連任何一條跨洋航線都冇覆蓋）。
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: 不過，星空聯盟覆蓋咗除南太平洋東部從智利聖地亞哥到大溪地之外嘅所有地區，呢個屬於拉塔姆航空公司（LATAM）旗下寰宇一家嘅一班航班。
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: 如果你想跳過南太平洋同南美洲西海岸，呢班機並唔係唯一嘅選擇。（見下文）
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: 1994年，阿塞拜疆嘅納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫地區亞美尼亞人對阿塞拜疆人發動戰爭。
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: 喺亞美尼亞嘅支持下成立咗一個新嘅共和國。不過，冇一個實體國家正式承認佢，甚至係亞美尼亞都唔承認。
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: 呢個地區嘅外交爭議持續損害亞美尼亞同阿塞拜疆之間嘅關係。
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: 運河區（荷蘭文：Grachtengordel）係17世紀阿姆斯特丹賓嫩斯塔德附近出名嘅地區。
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: 成個區因為佢獨特嘅文化歷史價值而被聯合國教科文組織列為世界遺產，佢嘅物業價值喺全國名列前茅。
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: 五漁村（Cinque Terre）嘅意思係「五塊地」，由位於意大利利古里亞地區嘅里奧馬焦雷、馬那羅拉、科爾尼利亞、韋爾納扎同蒙特羅索五個沿海小村莊組成。
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: 佢哋被列入聯合國教科文組織世界遺產名錄。
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: 幾個世紀以嚟，人們喺崎嶇陡峭嘅地形上精心建造梯田，一直到俯瞰大海嘅懸崖。
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: 佢嘅魅力之一就係冇明顯嘅企業插手發展。道路、火車同船隻將村莊連接埋，而汽車唔可以由外面入到。
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: 比利時同瑞士講嘅法文同法國講嘅法文有少少唔同，但佢哋好相似，足以相互理解。
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: 具體嚟講，比利時同瑞士法文嘅數字系統有啲微細嘅特點，同法國法文有啲唔同，而某啲字詞嘅發音亦有少少唔同。
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: 雖然咁講，但所有講法文嘅比利時同瑞士人喺學校都學過標準法文，所以佢哋都能夠理解標準法文嘅數字系統。
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: 喺世界好多地方，揮手係一種友好嘅手勢，表示「你好」。
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: 不過，喺馬來西亞，至少喺農村地區嘅馬來人當中，佢係指「過嚟」，類似於向身體方向屈食指，呢種手勢喺某啲西方國家使用，兼且只可以用於呢種目的。
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: 同樣，喺西班牙嘅英國遊客可能會將手掌面向揮手者（而唔係對住揮手對象）嘅揮手告別誤以為係返嚟嘅手勢。
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: 輔助語言係人工語言或人造語言，創造嘅目的係促進原本喺其他方面溝通困難嘅人士之間嘅交流。
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: 佢哋同通用語係分開嘅，通用語係一種自然語言或有機性語言，出於某種原因成為其他語言使用者之間嘅主要溝通方式。
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: 喺日頭最熱嘅時候，旅客可以體驗到海市蜃樓嘅錯覺，好似會出現水（或其他嘢）嘅幻象咁。
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: 如果旅客去追海市蜃樓，浪費寶貴嘅能量同剩低嘅水，噉樣可能係好危險嘅。
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: 就算係最熱嘅沙漠喺夜晚都會變得極之凍。因為保暖衣物不足而導致低溫症會非常危險。
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: 尤其係喺夏天，如果你決定徒步穿越雨林，你要小心啲蚊。
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: 就算你揸緊車穿越亞熱帶雨林，你打開門上車嗰幾秒鐘，就足夠啲蚊同你一齊上車喇。
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: 禽流感，或者更正式噉叫禽流行性感冒，可以感染鳥類同哺乳類動物。
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: 據報導，人類感染禽流感嘅病例唔到一千宗，但其中一啲係致命病例。
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: 雖然大多數都喺同家禽打交道嘅人，但對觀鳥者嚟講都有啲風險。
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: 挪威嘅典型特徵係，陡峭嘅峽灣同山谷突然出現又高幾乎又平坦嘅高原。
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: 呢啲高原通常會被稱為「vidde」，意思係一個廣闊開放、冇樹木同無邊無際嘅空間。
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: 喺羅加蘭郡同阿格德，佢哋通常叫做「hei」，意思係一片冇樹木、通常覆蓋住石南花嘅荒原。
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: 冰川並唔穩定，但從山上流落嚟。噉會導致裂開，形成裂縫，佢哋可能會被雪橋遮住。
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: 冰洞嘅洞壁同洞頂可能會倒塌，裂縫可能會閉合。
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: 喺冰川邊緣，巨大嘅冰塊突然變得鬆動、墜落，可能會從邊緣跳動或者再轆遠啲。
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: 山中度假勝地嘅旅遊旺季高峰通常喺印度夏天。
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: 不過，喺冬天，佢哋有住另一番嘅美態同魅力，好多山中度假勝地積咗大量嘅雪，並提供滑雪、單板滑雪等活動。
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: 只有少數航空公司仲會提供喪親票價，呢個價略低於最後一刻奔喪費票價。
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: 提供呢啲服務嘅航空公司包括加拿大航空、達美航空、漢莎航空（針對美國或加拿大起飛嘅航班）同西捷航空。
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: 喺任何情況下，你必須直接打電話畀航空公司預訂。
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
